subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
mechanics_first: **Frenzy (Level 3):** When you enter a Rage, you can make a single melee weapon attack.
**Mindless Rage (Level 6):** You gain Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while raging.
subclasses.lore_and_flavor: Berserkers are barbarians who define their rage by a terrifying, singular focus on violence.
